name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-vscode
description: DeepSeek Harness in VS Code: the DSH application runs beside the extension host and renders its own client shell in a webview.

dsh.runtimePath.description: Path to the DSH installation: a directory with package.json plus node_modules, or a source checkout. Empty uses DSH_VSCODE_RUNTIME, then the workspace.

dsh.nodePath.description: Node executable for the companion host; it must be 24.9 or newer. Empty uses DSH_VSCODE_NODE, then node on PATH.

dsh.apiBaseUrl.description: Messages-compatible API root for the DeepSeek provider. Empty uses DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL, then the public API.

dsh.terminalBackend.description: Where DSH shell tools run: a local child process under DSH sandbox policy and permission presets (local), or the VS Code integrated terminal (vscode), which is unconfined and disables permission presets.

dsh.providerMode.description: Model provider shape. openai-compatible is the company route: it adds a private Chat Completions route from dsh.llmBaseUrl and does not fall back to the public DeepSeek API. deepseek uses the public DeepSeek API instead.

dsh.providerRoute.description: Route name for the private provider, a lowercase hyphenated identifier. Deployment-owned: the generated launch overlay sets it, so a DSH profile edit cannot override it.

dsh.llmBaseUrl.description: Deployment-owned Chat Completions root of the company endpoint. This company build ships the internal gateway; users normally change only the API key.

dsh.llmModel.description: Model id the company route serves and lists. This company build ships the Qwen thinking variant; the active model selection remains profile-owned.

dsh.llmApiKeyEnv.description: Deployment-owned environment name that carries the company endpoint key into the application. The generated launch overlay sets it; the key itself stays in VS Code SecretStorage.

dsh.llmContextWindow.description: Context window declared for the company route's model. This company build ships 262,144 tokens (256K) for the Qwen gateway; it is deployment-owned, not a measurement of every endpoint.

dsh.llmMaxTokens.description: Output-token cap declared for the company route's model. Leave unset to keep the pi-ai adapter default (128,000 tokens). This sizes the model and does not cap each request.

dsh.limits.unaryBodyBytes.description: Largest text request body, in bytes, the DSH page sends over the unary transport route. Larger bodies must use the file-upload carrier.

dsh.limits.packageAssetCount.description: Largest number of published assets one client package may contribute to one launch.

dsh.limits.packageAssetBytes.description: Largest single client-package asset, in bytes, copied into the launch directory.

dsh.limits.packageAssetTotalBytes.description: Largest total of client-package assets, in bytes, copied into one launch directory.

dsh.limits.binaryResponseBytes.description: Largest response body, in bytes, one binary page request accepts, such as a plugin detail image.

dsh.update.feedUrl.description: HTTPS update feed or directory URL, or a Windows network share directory that contains release-feed.json. Empty disables update checks. A workspace cannot change this setting.

dsh.update.checkIntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between automatic update checks after startup. 0 keeps the update check manual only. A configured feed is checked at most once per interval. Application-scoped with the feed URL it governs.

dsh.localPlugins.description: Plugins mirrored inside the private network. Each row mounts one Loader entry from a local directory or module path.

path.description: Absolute path of the plugin directory or module inside the network.

commands.title: DSH: Set Private Endpoint API Key
DSH: Clear Private Endpoint API Key

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && tsdown && node scripts/transport-smoke.mjs && node scripts/package-vsix.mjs
